observations.title: Atlas exclusivity blocks the stated Europe direct plan, but current price-basis impact is valuation-method dependent

evidence.quote: Supplier shall not, whether directly or through any affiliate, agent, or other reseller, market, license, sell, or deliver the Platform to any customer whose principal place of business is within the Territory
Direct expansion into Europe is the primary growth vector, worth $6M ARR by FY2028.

evidence.sql: SELECT SUM(s.arr_usd) AS latest_arr_territory_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month s JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.country IN ('Germany','Netherlands','UK') AND c.customer_id <> 'CUST-0004' AND s.snapshot_month = DATE '2025-12-01'

observations.title: Recurring revenue tagging exceeds the stricter restated recurring test by $4.67507845M, but EV impact is valuation-method dependent

evidence.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT SUM(l.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' THEN l.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS tagged_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND l.service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.service_period_start) <> '' THEN l.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS restated_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND NOT ((LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND l.service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.service_period_start) <> '') THEN l.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS tagged_failing_restated_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND NOT ((LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND l.service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.service_period_start) <> '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tagged_failing_restated_lines FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line l JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON l.invoice_id=i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product p ON l.product_id=p.product_id WHERE year(to_date(i.invoice_date))=2025) SELECT ROUND(total_revenue,2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(tagged_revenue,2) AS tagged_revenue, ROUND(100*tagged_revenue/total_revenue,2) AS tagged_pct, ROUND(restated_revenue,2) AS restated_revenue, ROUND(100*restated_revenue/total_revenue,2) AS restated_pct, ROUND(tagged_failing_restated_amount,2) AS tagged_failing_restated_amount, tagged_failing_restated_lines FROM x

data_gaps: No revenue multiple settings were provided, so revenue-quality EV impacts are valuation-method dependent and not priced.
No payroll table or compensation benchmark was provided to support ADJ-004.
No product P&L or sunset support was provided for ADJ-007.
No true AR ledger was provided; working-capital analysis relies on weighted collection days rather than full traditional DSO.
Atlas renewal mechanics shown in management summary were not supported by the reviewed executed contract extract.
